[SWS_CRYPT_00506]
⌈
If CreateRandomGeneratorCtx() is called to
create a global-state RandomGeneratorCtx, the parameter initialize shall be
ignored by FC Crypto and the requested RandomGeneratorCtx shall be returned
without modification of its state.
⌋

cryp::RandomGeneratorCtx, the optional boolean parameter initialize shall be ig-
nored and the requested RandomGeneratorCtx shall be returned without modification
